design: Newly composed prompt combinations, 5 tasks x 2 templates x 8 pairs x 4 endpoints. Sites fixed to final and penultimate tokens for every task; no semantic role equivalence assumed. Swap writer output from opposite-answer donor or same-answer nuisance donor; self control. Replay only resulting selected head local-value change through native routing in a separate run. All token-valid pairs retained regardless of competence.
gate: Per task/template: >=4 pairs; both endpoints candidate correct >=.75; intended group full-vocabulary top1 >=.5. No per-item filtering. Nuisance competence separately reported.
hypotheses: Candidate operations are task-general contextual writers.
Internal write/value magnitude is insufficient to predict output influence.
Apparent task transfer may instead track fixed token position and template.
metrics: Internal writer and value displacement; full and isolated native-to-intervened KL; intended-answer-group NLL change; counterfactual donor-directed margin. Group NLL is not single-token CE.
selection: Operations and sites fixed from H580 before this panel. No selection on template1. Templates share lexical items; whole-task transfer not independent corpus sampling.
